authentication.delivery: Private fixture credential files for PostgreSQL clients. SQLx environment-only delivery is reduced assurance.

native_sql.cleanup: Exact owned PostgreSQL stopped and fixture port verified inactive; database, private credentials and logs preserved.

browser.cleanup: Verified every exact owned process stopped. Database, synthetic source, credentials, ownership and evidence retained.
browser.transport: Deterministic Codex protocol transport through actual Edge, server, runner and fresh SCRAM PostgreSQL.

limitations: Full #236 auditor delegation, early audits/headroom, decisions, grants, continuation, UI and concurrency/revocation acceptance remain incomplete.
Known accepted subtotals and invalid coverage do not establish a complete provider bill or the $10 assurance.
Environment-only fixture delivery has reduced assurance; no operating-system isolation claim.
Required hosted CI/CodeQL/quality/security is unavailable while Actions is disabled by organization administrators.
Dependency #392 and independent outcome review remain unresolved. Keep #402 draft and #236 open.
Historical Cargo advisory debt is not a clean audit. The stopped #193/#235 paired R4 remains permanently stopped.
